purpose: Validate the default-off grouped-retained route profiler and fix its cache visibility so it can see the existing one-stream gate cache instead of reporting false all-miss counts.
source_changes: Add GGML_DS4_GROUPED_RETAINED_ROUTE_PROFILE_OUT default-off CSV profiler in ggml-cpu.c.
Record role, layer, phase, tensor/type, unique experts, rows, expert bytes, logical bytes, cache contains/misses, and grouped-retained eligibility for gate/up/down/up_gate routes.
Add ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one_cache_contains as a read-only CUDA one-stream cache query. It uses one_cache_key_for and does not mutate cache LRU, hit, or miss counters.
Pass src0 data pointers and expert strides from CPU route builders so profiler cache queries use the same one-stream key as execution.

interpretation.cache_visibility_fix_result: The profiler now sees the active one-stream gate cache: gate cache_contains=19825 instead of the previous false zero. Up/down remain cache_contains=0, confirming the prompt-general baseline still has no retained GPU source path for up/down.
interpretation.optimization_implication: A future generalized >5 tok/s candidate cannot focus only on gate. It must either reduce up/down logical source movement/fallback at large scale or implement a joint grouped-retained path that preserves gate cache behavior while avoiding per-expert up/down staging.
